data.one_liner: Multi-platform client for Convex backend integration with real-time WebSockets and subscriptions.
data.what_it_does: Provides a Dart and Flutter interface over the Convex backend to run queries, mutations, and actions, and to subscribe to real-time updates. It supports web using pure Dart and native platforms using Rust FFI.
use_when: You are building a Flutter application backed by Convex.
You need real-time data synchronization via WebSocket subscriptions.
You require cross-platform support including web and native mobile/desktop.
avoid_when: Your backend is not Convex (e.g., using Firebase or Supabase instead).
You want to avoid the native Rust toolchain dependencies for desktop/mobile builds.
strengths: Full multi-platform support including pure Dart web implementation and native FFI.
Real-time query subscriptions and connection state monitoring streams.
Automatic token refresh and authentication state management.
weaknesses: Requires Rust toolchain and platform-specific build toolchains for native builds.
Platform-specific network entitlements/permissions must be manually configured for Android and macOS.
data.setup_notes: Requires adding pub dependency, plus Rust toolchain and platform toolchains for native platforms. Android needs INTERNET permission and macOS needs network client/server entitlements.
